newsitem.title: USA: Namibian Minerals to list on NASDAQ on April 11.
newsitem.headline: Namibian Minerals to list on NASDAQ on April 11.

text.p: Namibian Minerals Corp (NAMCO), currently listed in Canada and Namibia, is to also list on NASDAQ, the company said Thursday.
The official NASDAQ listing will occur on April 11, 1997.
"This is a reflection of growing U.S. investor interest in our development of marine technology to start mining from our Namibian diamond concessions," NAMCO chief executive Alastair Holberton said.
NAMCO is a marine diamond exploration and development company with 5,600 square kilometres of concesssions off the coasts of Namibia and South Africa.
Following a successful exploration program conducted throughout 1995 and 1996, the company is currently developing its mining system with SubSea Offshore Ltd, a unit of Dresser Industries.
Commercial production is on schedule to begin in the third quarter 1997, Holberton said.
